title: IMAP API Gateway
subtitle: High-performance IMAP & SMTP REST API Service
description: A high-performance REST API built in Go (Fiber) for interacting with IMAP and SMTP servers. It acts as an intermediary microservice, allowing clients to authenticate, manage domains, fetch directory trees, and interact with emails using a connection-pooled IMAP architecture.

architectureHighlights.title: Global IMAP Manager
architectureHighlights.description: Maintains an internal connection pool with a defined TTL and a connection limit. This ensures the app can handle multiple email clients efficiently without recreating IMAP connections on every request.

architectureHighlights.title: Session Auth
architectureHighlights.description: Stores authenticated user sessions securely in Redis, combined with stateless cookies and X-CSRF-Token to prevent CSRF attacks.

architectureHighlights.title: Graceful Shutdown
architectureHighlights.description: Intercepts SIGINT / SIGTERM for safely closing fiber server, PostgreSQL pool, and all cached IMAP connections in the pool.
